section.p: After an is configured and installed on a motor, it begins sending data to the . It undergoes a learning process during which the creates a unique, customized model of each motor. It measures the multi-axis vibration, magnetic field, and temperature conditions of the motor. With the help of this data, it detects critical anomalies and defects.

The can identify degradation that could lead to the following motor faults: power system, stator winding, rotor, motor shaft/balance, eccentricity, bearing, alignment, cooling system, loose foot, and overall motor performance.
